Anti-Corruption
public  officers  appointed  by  the  Cabinet  of
Ministers;
judicial  officers  and  scheduled  public  officers
appointed by the Judicial Service Commission;
staff  officers  in  Ministries  and  Government
Departments;
members  of  the  Constitutional  Council  appointed
in terms of Article 41A (1) (e) of the Constitution,
who are not members of Parliament;
persons appointed as Chairmen or members as the
case may be of any of the Commissions specified in
the Schedule to Article 41B of the Constitution;
staff officers of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka;
staff  officers  of  the  Independent  Commissions
established  under  Article  41A  (1)(c)  of  the
Constitution or under any Statute;
Chairpersons,  Commissioners,  members  and  staff
officers of independent regulatory and supervisory
Commissions or bodies established by or under any
Statute;
Chairmen,  Directors,  members  of  the  Boards  and
executive  officers  of  any  public  corporation
established by or under any Statute;
private staff members of the Members of Parliament,
members  of  Provincial  Councils  and  members  of
local  authorities;
officers of the Sri Lanka Army raised and maintained
in accordance with the provisions of the Army Act
(Chapter 357);
